name: coverage-mcp
objective: Coverage recette for the mcp domain: the privileged role tool_operator exercises every one of its 2 catalogued actions, asserting the documented posture (2 escalate, 0 deny). Proves the catalog/engine emit the right verdict for each action of this domain.
teaching: Even the tool_operator never gets a silent ALLOW on a sensitive mcp action: governed actions escalate to a human (I6); pure-deny actions stay denied for everyone. The whole sweep is replayable for audit (I4).

agents.system_prompt: You are the privileged tool_operator agent for the mcp system.

actions.rationale: HIGH action; privileged role tool_operator -> escalate (human approval gate).
